title: Cross-Surface Evidence and Schema Spine v1

common_envelope_model.description: Universal evidence envelope shared across all protocol surfaces. Every surface-specific event wraps its payload in this envelope. The envelope guarantees traceability, content-light classification, and cross-referencing to source-of-truth artifacts.

fields.description: Unique identifier for this evidence envelope. Generated at emission time. Used as the primary key in evidence ledgers and for cross-surface correlation.
Correlation identifier linking the evidence envelope to the originating request (e.g., MCP tool call, ACP message, A2A task dispatch). Enables end-to-end tracing across surfaces.
Agent session identifier. Links the evidence to a specific agent session lifecycle. Null for non-session events (e.g., service account attestations).
Mission identifier from fleet orchestration. Links the evidence to a specific mission dispatch. Null for non-mission events.
SHA256 hash of the actor identity (user, agent, subagent, service account, etc.). Content-light by design — the raw identity is never stored in the envelope.

fields.type: enum: mcp | acp | a2a | ssh | hosted_api | websocket | cli | cockpit | github_provider | telemetry_export | debug | static_docs
fields.description: Protocol surface that produced this evidence. Used for surface-specific filtering, risk correlation, and authority tier resolution.

fields.type: enum: read_only | analysis | validation | patch_proposal | mutation | attestation | admin
fields.description: Authority tier at which this event was emitted. Determines the governance gate that approved (or should have approved) the underlying action.
Identifier of the capability exercised (e.g., tool name, widget ID, command name). References the canonical capability manifest.
SHA256 hash of the input payload (tool parameters, message content, command arguments). Allows verification without storing raw input.
SHA256 hash of the output payload (tool result, message response, command output). Allows verification without storing raw output.
Identifier of the JSON Schema that validates the nested payload. Enables schema-aware processing and cross-surface schema spine validation.
Identifier of the approval receipt that authorized this action. Null for actions that do not require approval. References the approval receipt ledger.
Identifier of the policy decision that governed this action. Null when no policy decision was consulted. References the policy decision ledger.
OpenTelemetry-compatible trace identifier for distributed tracing across protocol surfaces. Enables correlation with OTLP-exported spans.

fields.type: list of { artifact_id: string (SHA256), artifact_kind: enum, path: string }
fields.description: References to artifacts produced or consumed by this event (reports, checkpoints, worktrees, attestations). Content-light — uses SHA256 hashes, not raw paths.

fields.type: enum: public_safe | private_local | sensitive_metadata | secret_bearing | forbidden_raw
fields.description: Content-light classification of the evidence payload. Determines export eligibility, redaction requirements, and static docs inclusion. public_safe: suitable for public docs. private_local: local-only. sensitive_metadata: contains metadata that could reveal patterns. secret_bearing: contains references to secrets or tokens. forbidden_raw: contains raw content that must never be persisted.
Identifier of the redaction scan that validated this envelope's content-light compliance. Null if redaction scan has not been performed.

fields.type: list of { ref_type: enum (evidence_ledger | finding | policy | attestation), ref_id: string }
fields.description: References to canonical source-of-truth artifacts that ground this evidence claim. Enables bidirectional traceability between evidence and governance artifacts.
Wall-clock timestamp of evidence emission. Used for ordering, TTL calculation, and temporal queries.
Identifier of the component that produced this evidence (e.g., 'agent_loop.v2', 'mcp_server.v1', 'github_provider.v1'). Used for versioned producer accountability.
Monotonic sequence number within the producer's event stream. Enables gap detection and ordering within a single producer.

proposed_schemas.description: Declarative manifest of all capabilities exposed by each protocol surface. Maps capability IDs to surface, authority tier, and required receipts. Single authority for capability discovery across all surfaces.

Envelope for intent-bearing messages across surfaces (MCP tool calls, ACP edit proposals, A2A task dispatches, SSH commands). Wraps the intent payload with actor identity, surface metadata, and correlation identifiers.

Record of a policy decision made by the governance engine. Captures the decision (allow/deny/defer), consulted rules, evidence considered, and decision rationale. Referenced by evidence envelopes via policy_decision_id.

Registry of all protocol descriptors (MCP, ACP, A2A, SSH, hosted API, WebSocket, CLI, cockpit). Each descriptor declares the protocol version, transport, authentication requirements, and surface authority tier.

Attestation that a specific MCP tool descriptor has been reviewed and approved for a given authority tier. Links the tool descriptor to the capability manifest and the approval receipt that authorized it.

ACP-specific message envelope wrapping session messages, edit proposals, and progress events. Extends the common evidence envelope with ACP-specific fields (editor type, session phase, proposal status).
Attestation that a remote A2A agent's agent card has been validated and its declared capabilities match the mission scope. Signed by the orchestrator after capability verification.
Receipt for an SSH command invocation that passed through the supervisor's subprocess governance guards. Captures the command hash, host identity, guard results, and output hash.
Receipt for a hosted API request that was routed through the local event fabric. Guarantees that hosted API actions produce local evidence. Captures tenant ID (hashed), endpoint, and response hash.
Schema for frontend widget projection data streamed over the WebSocket. Defines widget-scoped authorization filters and content-light classification for each widget projection payload.
Receipt for a CLI command execution. Captures the command, flags, exit code, and policy consultation results. Referenced by ACP and other surfaces when they must consult CLI-level policy.

Schema for the protocol composition risk register. Defines the structure for cross-surface attack path documentation, mitigation tracking, and blocking status. Each risk entry links to required schema receipts and tests.
